title: 10 Signs a Godly Man's Friendships Are Actually Doing Something
caption:
10 signs a godly man's friendships are actually doing something. Not the group chat. The real thing.

They know your actual sin, not just your highlight reel. You go quiet for a week and one of them notices. You've cried in front of at least one of them.

Woe to the one who falls with no one there to help him up (Ecclesiastes 4:10).

Isolation isn't strength. It's the place men actually rot.
